profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Care.com || Identity & Access Management Specialist
profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States
profile.summary: Hi I'm Eric, a professional software engineer.  With an education in Philosophy and background in teaching, I know how to listen critically and break down big picture problems into manageable tasks. I help companies implement authentication solutions tailored to complex business requirements and troubleshoot issues encountered along the way.

positions.locationName: Salt Lake City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Identity
positions.description:
• Migrated Care's social logins (Google, Apple, Facebook) to Auth0 — owned the project end to end across multiple services and platforms, including account linking, disconnect flows, and analytics instrumentation.
• Built Saved Search for provider job search — delivered the backend across GraphQ and gRPC pipelines in three tiers, from saved criteria through in-app new-result counts to email/push alerting.

positions.title: Software Engineer II - IAM
positions.description:
• Ported legacy Java monolith login systems to microservices and cloud-based Identity solutions, increasing Care’s login success rate and improving the overall security posture.
• Investigate, identify and resolve bugs, conduct root cause analysis, and implement solutions to improve the login flow’s reliability, performance, and scalability both daily and during on-call shifts.
• Work with other engineering teams to improve understanding and adoption of IAM industry standards.

positions.title: Senior Developer Support Eningeer
positions.description:
• Act as a technical leader and mentor to the Developer Support Engineer team, providing guidance on complex technical issues and helping to develop best practices.
• Develop internal tooling to help streamline case escalation workflows.
• Conduct root cause analysis and provide recommendations for improving the platform's reliability and performance.

positions.title: Developer Support Engineer
positions.description:
• Troubleshoot complex technical issues and work with the various engineering and security teams to identify and resolve bugs.
• Assist in the creation of global support policies as a member of the Support Advisory Group.
• Create and maintain technical documentation, including troubleshooting guides and best practices, to improve developer support processes.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.description:
• Developed full stack applications for small businesses including a dashboard app to monitor
real-time streamflow data using the US Geological Survey’s Water Services API.
• Incorporated technologies like Typescript, React, & MaterialUI on the front end paired with a Node.js, Express backend, utilizing Zod for database schema validation and type safety.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · Express.js · TypeScript · MongoDB · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineering Immersive Fellow
positions.description:
• Built projects using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node, Express, et al.
• MongoDB/Mongoose, PostgresQL and SQL databases
• Node w/ Express, Ruby on Rails, and Java/Spring backends
• Incorporated debugging strategies to ensure program integrity
• Plan, wrote, tested, and deployed multiple full-stack applications
• Leveraged third-party APIs and integrated them into web apps

positions.title: Assistant Operations Manager
positions.description:
• Oversaw daily operations of the nations largest fly fishing outfitter with a staff of over 40 guides
• Managed water usage based on permits; booked trips focused on client expectations and current conditions

positions.title: Mountain Direct Manager
positions.description:
• Strategized with senior management and implemented changes to advance our web presence, increase market share, expand local business relations, and surpass sales goals
• Hired, trained, and managed a team of technicians who delivered product directly to customers.
